registered: 2026-10-05 (#5870), before any engine was run on the sealed pages. Margin 0.25 fidelity points: the #5700 A5 A-vs-A floor (the same Flash read twice, each translated by Lite, 29 pages) had a 95 % CI of [-0.17, 0.22], so two reads of ONE engine already differ by about 0.2 on the mean.
measure: judged against a human reference: mean fidelity (1-5) of two blind Opus judges for the Lite (prompt v13) English made from each engine's read; the judges' source is the by-eye corrected transcription (#5695).
catastrophic_definition: a page is catastrophic for an arm when the engine returned no usable read (empty, timeout, refusal: its English is then scored 1, not dropped) or when either judge types an unreadable_fill invention in that arm's English (#5622: the only invention kind that is fabrication).
